name: What features are included in an accessible bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What features are included in an accessible bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessible bathroom remodel typically features a curbless walk-in shower, secure grab bars, wider entryways, slip-resistant flooring, comfort-height toilets, and open vanity space. A major decision factor depends on whether the space is being designed for general aging-in-place or for full wheelchair clearance. For seated mobility, the room requires adequate turning clearance and roll-in shower access with linear drains. If the remodel is focused on general fall prevention, simple modifications like replacing a high-sided bathtub with a low-threshold walk-in shower, adding targeted wall reinforcement for handrails, and upgrading lighting may be sufficient without widening the entire bathroom perimeter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible bathroom remodels often include zero-threshold walk-in showers, reinforced grab bars, slip-resistant tile, wider doorways, comfort-height toilets, and accessible vanity counters.
